expectations.evidence: Over-documented for senior dev: full JSDoc with @param-style descriptions, Example blocks in docstrings, formal method descriptions. Reads more like library documentation than senior dev's production code.
Proper TypeScript usage: union types, instanceof checks, type assertions (req as AuthenticatedRequest). Reasonable type design.
Standard Express imports, no unusual choices but nothing suspicious either. Clean import list.

Several AI tells: formal error messages ('An unexpected error occurred during authentication'), leaking role names in error ('Requires one of: admin, editor'), perfect structural symmetry across all functions, full docstrings on everything.

'An unexpected error occurred during authentication' is textbook formal AI English. 'Authentication is required before checking roles' is over-explanatory. 'Requires one of: admin, editor' leaks internals a senior dev would avoid.
